dgxNote: In *MiraVerse v1.6*, *Oman (OM: The Waterkeepers of the Mountains)* presents a mythohistorical narrative where ancient mountain-dwelling custodians, bound by sacred hydrological oaths, steward subterranean aquifers and celestial rain cycles—yet their authority is increasingly contested by desert nomads whose shifting oral traditions challenge the canonical hydro-mythology.

country.settingSummaryEn: A well-researched Omani mountain oasis village and terraced date/pomegranate garden irrigated by UNESCO-listed aflaj gravity channels (#1207), paired with a distinct Dhofar frankincense trading trail (#1010).
country.settingSummaryAr: قرية واحة جبلية عُمانية ومدرجات نخيل ورمان تُروى بقنوات الأفلاج المسجلة في اليونسكو (#1207)، مع مسار متميز لتجارة اللبان الظفاري (#1010).
country.settingSummaryArabizi: Qaryat waha jabaliya 3umaniya turwa bi-qanawat il-aflaj (UNESCO #1207) ma3 masar tijarat il-luban.
country.folkloreAndEpistemicFrameEn: Epistemic & Safety Note: UNESCO (#1207) documents the real hydrological engineering and equitable community time-sharing (athar) of Oman's aflaj. Popular folk tales attributing aflaj construction to Prophet Sulayman (Solomon) and the jinn, as well as legends of the "Lost City of Ubar", are labeled explicitly as folklore/legend rather than engineering history. Religious figures are never depicted as game NPCs.
country.folkloreAndEpistemicFrameAr: ملاحظة معرفية: توثق اليونسكو (#1207) الهندسة المائية الحقيقية ونظام «الأثر» لتقسيم المياه في الأفلاج. أما الروايات الشعبية حول بناء سليمان والجن للأفلاج أو أسطورة «أوبار» فتُصنَّف صراحةً كتراث قصصي لا كتاريخ هندسي، ولا يتم تجسيد أي شخصيات دينية.
country.folkloreAndEpistemicFrameArabizi: Mulahaza: Handasat il-aflaj muwaththaqa fil-UNESCO (#1207), amma qisas Sulayman wal-jinn wa Ubar fahiya folklore.
country.diasporaNarrativeEn: For Omani families at home and abroad, the fair sharing of mountain water (athar), the welcoming scent of Hojari frankincense, and shared rosewater halwa embody stewardship and community harmony.
country.diasporaNarrativeAr: لعائلات عُمان في الوطن والمهجر، يجسد تقاسم مياه الأفلاج بالعدل وعبق اللبان الحوجري والحلوى العُمانية بماء الورد قيم الأمانة والتكافل.
country.diasporaNarrativeArabizi: Li-3ailat 3uman fil-mahjar, taqasum miyah il-falaj wa 3abaq il-luban yujassid il-takaful.
